best_candidate_evidence.quote_en: Critical isolation/approval tests have **zero exceptions**, cannot be offset by AI scores, and revised invariants need negative tests. best_candidate_evidence.heading_context_en: 1. Screen Function Specification / Integrations and Acceptance Criteria / SF-016 Transaction, event and audit behavior
best_candidate_evidence.quote_en: **Confirmed:** Durable changes propagate `tenant_id`, `revision`, `actor_id`, `occurred_at` and correlation context. They are server/interface metadata, not mandatory user-editable fields. Case mutations, approval decisions and outbox inserts commit in one ACID transaction; search/webhooks reconcile asynchronously. best_candidate_evidence.heading_context_en: 2. API Specification / API Inventory and Responsibilities / Shared authentication and authorization — API-045
best_candidate_evidence.quote_en: Authorization combines role, tenant, workspace membership, case sensitivity, originating document ACL, requested action and segregation of duties. Edge checks do not replace transaction-time domain checks. Navigation hiding is not authorization. Baseline roles are `Analyst`, `Reviewer`, `Admin`, `Auditor`, `Service`; map `Workspace Admin`, `Owner`, `Member`, `approver` and `Operators` before implementation. An Analyst cannot approve their own high-risk recommendation; approval tasks prohibit self approval. Auditor reads are redacted and cannot edit case content. [pp.11,22,85; api:r2:c5:f2–f3; api:r2:c8:f7–f8; api:r2:c27:f5; SF-002/OQ-001.]

best_candidate_evidence.heading_context_en: 1. Screen Function Specification / Scope and Users / SF-002 Users and permission prerequisites
best_candidate_evidence.quote_en: **Confirmed:** Authorization combines role, tenant, workspace membership, case sensitivity, document ACL, requested action and segregation of duties. Every request binds an authenticated principal and tenant. Resource-boundary checks apply independently of hidden or disabled controls; domain checks run again within transactions and document ACL filtering precedes model text release. Approval tasks prohibit self approval; specifically, an analyst cannot approve their own high-risk recommendation. Authorized overrides require elevated role, a secondary reviewer and audited reason. (pp.11, 21–23, 46, 85 [screen_functions:r1:c5:f4, screen_functions:r1:c8:f1–f6, screen_functions:r1:c15:f8, screen_functions:r1:c27:f4]).
